plainTranslation: {friendNamePossessive} Saturn touches {readerPossessive} Moon: {friendName} brings the structure, and you bring the feeling. Trust grows when {friendName} is consistent and you let your needs be visible.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The growth edge is learning how to receive what is being offered. {friendName} may express care through reliability and practical support rather than overt displays of emotion. You may need to let that care land instead of waiting for it to arrive in a more dramatic form.
advice: {friendNamePossessive} commitment is the gift here. {friendName} keeps showing up, keeps listening, and keeps tending to what matters. Trust is built through practice. You and {friendName} can build something steady, grounding, and lasting when care stays visible.
summaryShort: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
